name: variable-clock
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vclk_in (clk_in 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 10n 0 10.1n 0.9 16n 0 30n 0 30.1n 0.9 40n 0 55n 0 55.1n 0.9 72n 0 90n 0 90.1n 0.9 100n 0 120n 0 120.1n 0.9 126n 0 150n 0]
XDUT (clk_in valid duty0 duty1 duty2 duty3 duty4 duty5 duty6 duty7) duty_cycle_meter_8b

tran tran stop=150n maxstep=100p
save clk_in valid duty0 duty1 duty2 duty3 duty4 duty5 duty6 duty7
